nodes.title: Framed Poster — Leopard with Pearl Necklace Wall Art
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A striking horizontal framed poster that balances whimsy and sophistication. The image — a poised leopard being adorned with a pearl necklace by gloved hands — brings playful elegance to a living room, office, or gallery wall. Printed on museum-grade, matte paper with vivid pigment inks, the artwork sits behind clear plexiglass and is set in a clean wooden frame available in black or white. Pre-installed hanging hardware means it arrives ready to mount, and multiple sizes let you choose a scale that complements a cozy corner or a bold focal wall. The result is a curated look that elevates everyday spaces with a touch of refined, unexpected charm.

Product features
- Museum-grade archival matte paper for long-lasting color and no yellowing
- Vibrant pigment inks for bright, true-to-design colors
- Pre-installed hanging hardware for easy, ready-to-hang display
- Solid wooden frame options in black or white with plexiglass front
- Available in multiple sizes; designed for indoor use

Care instructions
- If the poster does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, dry cloth. To remove spots or smudges from acrylic or glass, we recommend applying glass cleaner to a clean, soft, dry cloth or paper towel and then to the surface so that the cleaner does not settle on the frame, then buff the surface dry to remove any streaks.

nodes.title: Tennis Court Framed Art Print — Aerial Matchday Poster
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A horizontal framed poster that captures the electric hush of a tennis match from a bird’s-eye view. Printed on museum-grade, matte paper with vivid pigment inks, the scene’s layered green court and packed stands glow with color and texture beneath a protective plexiglass face. The clean wooden frame (black or white) and pre-installed hanging hardware make it easy to display in a living room, home office, or sports-themed nook. Sized to fit multiple wall spaces, this piece brings a calm, sunlit stadium moment into everyday rooms — a quiet celebration of focus, rhythm, and the crowd’s energy.

nodes.title: Motivational Poster – “Winning Isn’t For Everyone” Medal Wall Art
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A framed vertical poster that speaks with quiet, defiant humor. The image shows an Olympic-style medal being scribbled with the line “Winning isn’t for everyone,” turning a symbol of triumph into a cheeky, human moment. Hung in a simple black or white wooden frame with plexiglass protection and museum-grade matte paper, the piece reads well from across a room and adds a conversational edge to living rooms, home offices, gyms, or entryways. It settles into spaces where athletes, competitors, or anyone who appreciates dry wit gather — the sort of artwork that sparks a knowing smile and invites a conversation about effort, pressure, and the value of showing up.

nodes.title: Focus Motivational Poster — Classical Sculpture Wall Art
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A framed vertical poster that brings quiet intensity to any room. Matte, museum-grade paper and archival pigment inks render deep blacks and sculpted highlights with an artful, gallery feel. The image — a classical figure viewed from behind beneath the single word “FOCUS” — creates a contemplative, driven atmosphere. The slim wooden frame and plexiglass front keep the look modern and low-reflective, while pre-installed hanging hardware makes it simple to place above a desk, in a studio, or inside a minimalist living space. Available in multiple sizes and finished in black or white frame options to complement clean, monochrome interiors.
